protocol.source: training prefixes and next training items only
protocol.recent_older_rule: most recent match versus an older-half match in the same frequency stratum
protocol.random_control_rule: distinct singleton deletions in the same frequency and lag stratum; run length exactly one
protocol.replacement_rule: disabled; no new mask token or PAD replacement
protocol.candidate_rule: IDs 1..itemnum excluding original full-prefix observations except target

architecture.readout: maximum index with sequence != 0; empty prefixes excluded
architecture.replacement_probe_reason: Not preregistered: positional embeddings and padding can change features
architecture.scope: Structural dependency offsets of the supplied gated NextItNet, not measured importance

pos_neg_margin_category_breakdown.availability: Item categories unavailable; category lists intentionally empty

metrics.four_category_macro_reason: This call contains one ModelView; four category user samples are required for a macro estimate and independently stratified bootstrap

diagnostic_cost.accounting: Single-device synchronized elapsed time includes CPU work; host GPU budget accounting remains authoritative

metric_definitions.protocol: Preregistered sampling and matching rules printed before execution; no model fitting or checkpoint changes.
metric_definitions.coverage: Explicit counts of sampled prefixes, scored variants and exclusion/matching failures; unmatched comparisons are absent, never zero effects.
metric_definitions.architecture: Structural offsets include every causal convolution and gated causal-summary dependency. Numerical causality and padding checks are local checks, not proofs for all inputs.
metric_definitions.chunked_rank_synthetic_check: Rank counter and ascending-ID tie handling checked against exhaustive sorting across synthetic chunk sizes.
metric_definitions.embedding_collapse_score: Mean sampled off-diagonal item-embedding cosine mapped from [-1,1] to [0,1]. 0.5 means mean cosine zero; this alone does not measure recommendation diversity or generalization.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_margin_mean: Mean aligned positive-minus-sampled-negative score on valid training-loader positions; training fit only.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_margin_p10: Empirical lower tenth percentile of valid training-loader score margins; null when absent.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_neg_beats_pos_rate: Fraction of valid training-loader positions with negative margin.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_small_margin_rate: Fraction of valid training-loader positions with margin below protocol eps.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_margin_category_breakdown: Counts of low/wrong-margin training positions; item category lists are empty because categories are unavailable.
metric_definitions.training_prefix_hr10_user_mean: Exact eligible-catalog HR@10, averaged within user then across sampled users. Targets are training interactions, so this is in-sample diagnostic fit, not host validation HR@10.
metric_definitions.intervention_effects: Paired changed-minus-original ranks, HR@10 and mean sampled-negative margins; positive delta_rank means worse target rank. Top-10 overlap is intersection size divided by original top-10 size. Effects average prefixes within user, then users. CI95 resamples those user means with replacement; null below two users. Control-adjusted deltas subtract corresponding matched-control means; recent_minus_older compares matched deletion effects directly.
metric_definitions.strata: Same user-weighted effects within fixed prefix-length, training target-frequency, training terminal-to-target transition-frequency and repeated-target strata. Sparse intervals and many comparisons require caution.
metric_definitions.baseline_observations: Original-prefix ranks, HR@10, eligible-catalog size and measured strata. Eligibility uses all earlier training observations, including those outside the model window; target retained once even when repeated.
metric_definitions.paired_observations: Auditable paired effects. Deletion position shifts are absolute model-input index changes after left-padded repacking: +1 before the deleted token and 0 after it. Reachable-membership changes compare each retained token's lag from the terminal position against structural offsets; permutation correspondence is unavailable.
metric_definitions.four_category_macro: Unavailable from a single category call; never substitute a single-category estimate or pool category users as a macro estimate.
metric_definitions.category_breakdown: Empty because item-category metadata is unavailable; dataset-level routing is unchanged.
metric_definitions.unavailable: Unobserved data and unmeasured effects must not be inferred as measurements.
metric_definitions.diagnostic_cost: Measured synchronized elapsed time; GPU compute time is not separately measured. Host accounting determines consumed search budget.
